title: Pet-Claim Look-Back by Booking Volume — Listings Decision Card
content:
# Pet-Claim Look-Back by Booking Volume

*Decision card for Roamhaven Listings. It fixes the period over which a listing's pet-damage claims, and their losses, are read when the listing's pet-fee ceiling is worked out on the day of a pet-fee reset.*

## Rule

The guest reviews counted by the quality assessments recorded on the listing within the last three months (fewer than three whole months before the day of the reset) are added up. Then:

- when they come to **15 or more**, the pet-claim look-back is shortened to the last **6** whole months before the day of the reset, because a busy listing's recent claims already show its pet costs;
- when they come to **fewer than 5**, the pet-claim look-back is lengthened to the last **24** whole months before the day of the reset, because a quiet listing needs a longer record;
- otherwise — from 5 up to 14 — the standard pet-claim look-back applies: the last **12** whole months before the day of the reset.

Whichever look-back applies, a claim falls within it according to the date part of its filing moment (the date the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claim was filed).

## Decision table

| Guest reviews counted by the listing's quality assessments of the last three months | Pet-damage claims and their losses are read over |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | the last 6 whole months |
| 5 to 14 | the last 12 whole months |
| fewer than 5 (none included) | the last 24 whole months |

## Edge readings (hypothetical counts)

| Reviews added up | Look-back |
|---|---|
| 15 | 6 whole months — 15 is "15 or more" |
| 14 | 12 whole months |
| 5 | 12 whole months — 5 is not "fewer than 5" |
| 4 | 24 whole months |
| 0, no assessment recorded in the three months | 24 whole months |

## Worked case (hypothetical listing)

One quality assessment was recorded on a listing within the last three months, and it counted 9 guest reviews. The reviews add up to 9, between 5 and 14, so the pet-damage claims of the last 12 whole months before the day of the reset are the ones read.
